edges.cite: POSA2, Acceptor-Connector, context/example: connection-oriented networked client-server applications
edges.note: Decouples connection establishment from service processing in client-server systems
Acceptor/connector roles manage endpoint setup and teardown for socket-based stream connectors

edges.cite: EIP, Guaranteed Delivery: each hop persists the message before acknowledging; sender retains until acknowledged
edges.note: Store-and-forward delivery is built on per-hop acknowledgement

edges.cite: Stevens, TCP/IP Illustrated Vol.1: acknowledgments advance the send window
edges.note: Acks are the events that slide the flow-control window
Gateway aggregation is the aggregator mechanism applied at the system edge to fan-in backend responses
The API composer joins per-service results in memory - an aggregator with a completeness condition
Preemptive RTOS scheduling breaks software-timed pin toggling; bit-banged protocols must run at highest priority or with interrupts locked

edges.cite: Garlan & Shaw, An Introduction to Software Architecture: components register procedures with events; event announcement implicitly invokes them
edges.note: Registered callbacks are the invocation mechanism of implicit invocation
Event connectors deliver occurrences to registered observer procedures, i.e. callbacks
The C idiom that gives a plain function-pointer callback per-registration state via an opaque void*
The C-level registration mechanism used to build implicit-invocation dispatch without closures
EIP notes claim check keeps bulky/sensitive payloads out of the channel; message-level form of the Limit Exposure tactic
The parked payload is deposited and redeemed through a data-access connector to the shared store
The dispatcher provides naming, registration and routing between clients and servers - the distributor connector services
Name-to-server resolution at request time is runtime discovery of service providers

edges.cite: POSA1, Client-Dispatcher-Server: adds location transparency to client-server systems via a name service
edges.note: Pattern is defined as an extension of client-server structuring

edges.cite: EIP, Message Router: the content-based router is presented as the archetypal message router
edges.note: Design-level routing component realizing the architectural router pattern

edges.cite: EIP, Message Broker: the central hub determines destinations using router patterns such as content-based routing
edges.note: Broker hubs depend on content-based routing logic

edges.cite: EIP, Request-Reply: the reply carries a Correlation Identifier so the requestor can match it to the request
edges.note: Standard pairing in asynchronous request-reply exchanges
Matching a later result to the accepted request requires a correlation id across the decoupled exchange
The propagated trace id is a correlation identifier stamped on every hop of a request

edges.cite: Shaw & Garlan, Software Architecture: communicating-sequential-processes (Hoare) listed among independent-component/process styles
edges.note: Channel-based rendezvous is the interaction primitive of the communicating-processes style

edges.cite: Effective Go: 'Do not communicate by sharing memory; instead, share memory by communicating'
edges.note: The two canonical inter-task data exchange disciplines

edges.cite: Fowler, Event Sourcing; Vernon, Implementing DDD: state changes are captured and persisted as a sequence of domain events
edges.note: The event log that event sourcing treats as source of truth is a log of domain events

edges.cite: Richardson, microservices.io (Domain event / Saga): choreography-based coordination works by services publishing and reacting to domain events
edges.note: Domain events are the coordination currency of choreographed workflows
A single in-process hub interposed between event sources and subscribers - the Use an Intermediary tactic
In-process single-hub publish-subscribe: sources publish to the aggregator, clients subscribe once
Replaces N per-element listeners with one ancestor handler - a resource-efficiency mechanism for large/dynamic UI trees

edges.cite: EIP, ch.10 Messaging Endpoints: Event-Driven Consumer is an endpoint pattern
edges.note: One of the two canonical endpoint consumption modes
Each SEDA stage consumes queued events via handler invocation by the stage's thread pool

edges.cite: POSA1, Forwarder-Receiver: provides transparent IPC for peer-to-peer interaction models
edges.note: Named as the pattern's target interaction model

edges.cite: POSA1, Broker (implementation/See Also): message transfer between brokers can use Forwarder-Receiver
edges.note: Load-bearing transport mechanism inside broker systems
An ACL is assembled from gateway/translator objects at the context seam (Evans describes facades, adapters, translators)
The gateway object is the canonical outbound adapter behind a port to an external system

edges.cite: Meszaros, Half-Object + Protocol (PLoP): same pattern; the catalog splits object-level mechanism from distribution structure
edges.note: Same-name-two-realms pair

edges.cite: Nygard, Release It!, Handshaking: the server protects itself by cooperatively throttling or refusing new work
edges.note: Cooperative demand control realizing admission-control throttling
Dean & Barroso's mechanism exploits replicated computations to cut tail latency - an implementation of the multiple-copies performance tactic

edges.cite: EIP, ch.10 Messaging Endpoints: Idempotent Receiver is an endpoint pattern
edges.note: Duplicate-tolerant consumption at the endpoint

edges.cite: EIP, Idempotent Receiver: duplicates arise from the resend mechanisms of guaranteed delivery; Kleppmann, DDIA: idempotence makes at-least-once delivery safe
edges.note: At-least-once delivery depends on duplicate-tolerant receivers

edges.cite: Richardson, microservices.io, Transactional Outbox: the relay may publish a message more than once, so consumers must be idempotent
edges.note: Outbox delivery semantics require idempotent consumption

edges.cite: IEEE 1516 HLA: Data Distribution Management services provide region-based update filtering (interest management) in the RTI
edges.note: DDM is interest management standardized in the federation architecture
Server-owned state replicated to many clients scales only by filtering each client's update stream

edges.cite: Agha, Actors; Erlang/OTP docs: each actor/process receives asynchronous messages through its mailbox
edges.note: The mailbox is the actor model's message reception mechanism
RTOS mailbox kernel objects are a standard inter-task communication primitive tasks pend on

edges.cite: EIP, Message (root pattern): the messaging style integrates applications by exchanging discrete messages over channels
edges.note: The style's unit of exchange

edges.cite: EIP, ch.10 Messaging Endpoints: Message Dispatcher is an endpoint pattern
edges.note: Single consumer distributing to in-process performers

edges.cite: EIP, Message Dispatcher: explicitly compared with Competing Consumers for parallel consumption
edges.note: In-process dispatch vs multiple independent consumers on one channel

edges.cite: EIP, Message Expiration / Guaranteed Delivery: with guaranteed delivery messages never expire on their own, so expiration bounds persistent retention
edges.note: Keeps persisted messages from accumulating forever

edges.cite: EIP, Message Filter: described as a special form of Message Router (single output channel, may discard)
edges.note: Routing decision degenerates to pass/drop
A queue is the canonical implementation of a point-to-point message channel

edges.cite: Azure Cloud Design Patterns, Queue-Based Load Leveling: introduce a message queue between task and service to absorb bursts
edges.note: The tactic is defined in terms of a message queue
Prioritized RTOS tasks communicate predominantly via kernel message queues

edges.cite: Simon, An Embedded Software Primer: ISRs enqueue function pointers onto a queue the main loop drains
edges.note: The architecture is organized around the queue mechanism

edges.cite: EIP, Message Translator: same pattern; the architecture entry is its system-integration scale
edges.note: Same-name-two-realms pair (identical id in both realms - see notes)

edges.cite: EIP, Canonical Data Model: apply a Message Translator at each endpoint to convert into and out of the canonical model
edges.note: CDM depends on translators at every seam
Converting message data formats between mismatched participants is the adaptor connector role
Coalescing small segments cuts per-packet network overhead - a protocol-level resource-efficiency mechanism

edges.cite: RFC 896: new small segments are held while previously sent data remains unacknowledged
edges.note: The algorithm is keyed on outstanding acknowledgements

edges.cite: Staltz, Cycle.js / Unidirectional UI architectures: MVI is defined as functions over observable streams of intents and states
edges.note: The style is stated directly in terms of reactive streams
Push-based delivery of values from producers to subscribed observers is the event connector role

edges.cite: EIP, ch.10 Messaging Endpoints: Polling Consumer is an endpoint pattern
edges.note: Consumer-paced synchronous reception

edges.cite: EIP: Polling Consumer and Event-Driven Consumer presented as the two consumption alternatives
edges.note: Pull vs push message consumption

edges.cite: POSA2, Half-Sync/Half-Async: a queueing layer mediates between the synchronous and asynchronous layers
edges.note: The mediating queue is a producer-consumer structure

edges.cite: Welsh et al., SEDA (SOSP 2001): stages are connected by explicit event queues drained by per-stage thread pools
edges.note: Every stage boundary is a producer-consumer queue
A bounded queue between producers and consumers absorbing bursts is the load-leveling tactic in-process

edges.cite: EIP, Publish-Subscribe Channel: delivers a copy of each published message to every subscriber - the style's delivery mechanism at channel scale
edges.note: Same-name-two-realms pair
Components broadcasting what happened to all interested parties rides on pub-sub channels

edges.cite: EIP, Remote Procedure Invocation (integration style): names RPC mechanisms (CORBA, RMI, .NET Remoting) as its realization
edges.note: Same-name-two-realms pair (mechanism vs integration style)

edges.cite: Mehta-Medvidovic-Phadke connector taxonomy: procedure call connectors include remote procedure call variants
edges.note: RPC is the distributed species of the procedure-call connector

edges.cite: POSA1, Broker: client-side proxies marshal invocations and transmit them to remote servers - RPC stub machinery
edges.note: Broker systems are built on RPC-style proxy/marshaling machinery
Cross-boundary method invocation on distributed objects is carried by RPC stubs and marshaling
Client-server interaction is a request-reply exchange; the style presupposes the two-message conversation

edges.cite: EIP, Request-Reply: the messaging counterpart of RPC's call-return conversation
edges.note: RPC-style integration over messaging is built from request-reply

edges.cite: EIP, Request-Reply: the request should carry a Return Address naming the reply channel
edges.note: Standard pairing
Decoupled reply routing needs the request to name where the result should be delivered

edges.cite: EIP, Scatter-Gather: uses an Aggregator to collect and combine the replies
edges.note: Aggregator is the gather half
Gateway aggregation is scatter-gather performed by the edge gateway over backend services
Quorum reads/writes fan a request out to replicas in parallel and gather w/r responses (mechanism described in Kleppmann, DDIA)

edges.cite: EIP, ch.10 Messaging Endpoints: Selective Consumer is an endpoint pattern
edges.note: Predicate-scoped consumption at the endpoint

edges.cite: EIP: filtering can be placed in the channel (Message Filter) or at the consumer (Selective Consumer) - discussed as alternatives
edges.note: Same predicate, different placement
The shared-data style's central store is realized in-process/on-node by a commonly addressable memory region

edges.cite: Kopetz, Real-Time Systems: the temporal firewall is defined as a unidirectional time-controlled shared-memory interface
edges.note: The connector is specified directly over shared memory

edges.cite: Qt documentation, Signals & Slots: introduced as a type-safe alternative to the callback technique
edges.note: Same role, added type safety and many-to-many connection
connect() registers interest; emit announces the event and implicitly invokes all connected slots

edges.cite: Stevens, TCP/IP Illustrated Vol.1: TCP's reliable stream delivery is governed by sliding-window flow control
edges.note: Socket/stream connectors depend on window flow control for pacing
The advertised window is the protocol-level mechanism bounding the arrival rate a receiver accepts

edges.cite: EIP, ch.7 Message Routing: Splitter is cataloged among the message-routing patterns
edges.note: Routes the parts of a composite message onward as individual messages

edges.cite: EIP, Composed Message Processor: combine Splitter, router and Aggregator
edges.note: Split-process-rejoin pipeline
Copying each message unchanged to an inspection channel is the message-level capture mechanism feeding central log/traffic stores
Recording traffic as it flows for later inspection is the Audit tactic applied at the channel

notes: All 44 g2 (communication) elements bridged; 0 unbridged. Same-name/two-realm pairs bridged explicitly: message-translator->message-translator (WARNING: the id 'message-translator' is identical verbatim in both realms - Phase 4 build must namespace realms or rename one), publish-subscribe-channel->publish-subscribe-architectural-style, remote-procedure-call->remote-procedure-invocation, half-object-plus-protocol->half-object-plus-protocol-arch, message-queue->message-channel. MISSING arch targets found while bridging (demand-driven growth candidates): (1) a flow-control/backpressure tactic or connector property - sliding-window-flow-control and handshaking had to settle for manage-event-arrival/throttling; (2) a service-registry/service-discovery pattern (Richardson) - only the 'discover' tactic exists; client-dispatcher-server and any lookup mechanism want it; (3) an in-process event-bus/event-channel element distinct from message-bus - event-aggregator settled for use-an-intermediary + pub-sub style; (4) a delivery-semantics element (at-least-once/exactly-once) - idempotent-receiver bridges via guaranteed-delivery/transactional-outbox instead; (5) a networked-game state-replication reference architecture beyond authoritative-server (area-of-interest/client-prediction family) - interest-management settled for HLA DDM + authoritative-server; (6) a retained-mode UI component-tree/GUI-toolkit runtime element - event-delegation had only a resource-efficiency tactic as target; (7) a tail-latency/latency-hiding performance tactic - hedged-request settled for maintain-multiple-copies-of-computations.
